source.name: A dialog created with keyboard: false must stay open however often Escape is pressed
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43070) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Escape must not dismiss a dialog opened with keyboard: false
journey.goal: The confirmation dialog stays open however often Escape is pressed, so the user can still enter the code and send the transfer

functionalJourney.title: Confirm with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking the backdrop does not close the dialog; entering the code and clicking Send completes the transfer

guards.title: Cancel transfer still closes the dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Tabbing to Cancel transfer and pressing Enter closes the dialog and records the cancellation

plan.root_cause: The Escape keydown listener in DialogBase._addDialogListeners returns early for modal dialogs, preventing event.preventDefault() from being called. While the native cancel listener should prevent default, under certain conditions (e.g., after repeated backdrop transitions) it fails to do so, allowing Escape to close the dialog. This causes the dialog to close on the third Escape press despite keyboard:false.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Escape keydown handler in DialogBase._addDialogListeners to call preventDefault() and return early for modal dialogs when keyboard:false, while preserving existing behavior for non-modal dialogs and modal dialogs with keyboard:true. This guarantees that Escape does not trigger the dialog's close action when keyboard is disabled.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will no longer dismiss the dialog when keyboard:false, allowing users to press Escape repeatedly without losing focus or closing the dialog, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: May affect subclasses that rely on the keydown listener for custom Escape behavior (though the listener only hides when keyboard:true).
Ensure that modal dialogs with keyboard:true still close on Escape (unchanged).
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape any number of times does not close the dialog when keyboard:false and backdrop:static.
Verify that pressing Escape closes the dialog when keyboard:true.
Verify that focus remains on the OTP input after Escape presses.
Verify that submitting a valid OTP still sends the transfer and hides the dialog.
Verify that clicking the Cancel transfer button still cancels the transfer without closing the dialog.
